title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF — March 26, 2026**

Bitcoin flat at $68,446, but the real action isn't price—it's supply disappearing.

**THE SETUP:** Extreme fear reading at 10. Five straight months of red candles. Bears calling for $47K while institutions quietly executed the biggest coordinated accumulation of this cycle. $787 million into Bitcoin ETFs in one week. Japan's $1.5 trillion pension fund formally researching Bitcoin allocation. Kraken just got a Federal Reserve master account—that's a perma
